This page lists the IAM roles and permissions for Google Kubernetes Engine. To search through all roles and permissions, see the [role and permission index](https://docs.cloud.google.com/iam/docs/roles-permissions) .

<td>Kubernetes Engine Admin
<p>( <code>roles/ container.admin</code> )</p>
<p>Provides access to full management of clusters and their Kubernetes API objects.</p>
<p>To set a service account on nodes, you must also have the Service Account User role ( <code>roles/iam.serviceAccountUser</code> ) on the <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/how-to/hardening-your-cluster#use_least_privilege_sa">user-managed service account that your nodes will use</a> .</p>
<p>Lowest-level resources where you can grant this role:</p>
<ul>
<li>Project</li>
</ul></td>
